Japan's real, PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose roughly 20-fold from 1950 to 2016, about a 2,000% increase. My earlier answer of about tenfold was wrong: Maddison-style estimates put 1950 near $1,900 and 2016 near $38,000 in 1990 international dollars. I'm working from recalled figures, not a live data check, so the exact multiple could differ somewhat.

CONFIDENCE: 75
